public_claim_boundary: This contract is not Harbor execution evidence, not Harbor acceptance, not hosted leaderboard readiness, and not v1 readiness. It defines the public-safe SDK adapter target for future verified Harbor runs.

dataset_shape.source_of_truth: AuthZBench-SaaS task manifests and rendered task context
private_task_inputs: rendered context only for the agent

adapter_components.name: dataset_builder
adapter_components.responsibility: Build Harbor task directories from AuthZBench-SaaS manifests without duplicating benchmark truth.

adapter_components.name: task_context_renderer
adapter_components.responsibility: Render the same context contract used by python3 -m authzbench.run.

adapter_components.name: runner_bridge
adapter_components.responsibility: Invoke the Harbor no-tools or tool-agent lane with rendered context and an artifact output path.

adapter_components.name: output_collector
adapter_components.responsibility: Collect the agent submission from /logs/artifacts/submission.json or the declared Harbor artifact path.

adapter_components.name: verifier_scorer_bridge
adapter_components.responsibility: Run AuthZBench-SaaS scorer-controlled replay and translate the result into Harbor verifier output.

adapter_components.name: metadata_normalizer
adapter_components.responsibility: Emit benchmark source SHA, benchmark fingerprint, comparability key, harness type, model, agent, tool access, timeout, source-summary hashes, and private-pack metadata when applicable.

adapter_components.name: artifact_redaction_policy
adapter_components.responsibility: Keep private manifests, raw private outputs, captures, credentials, local paths, routes, seeds, and oracles out of tracked public artifacts.

adapter_components.name: dataset_skeleton_builder
adapter_components.responsibility: Generate a public-only Harbor-shaped dataset skeleton with instruction.md, task.toml, environment context, verifier manifest, and tests/test.sh without claiming Harbor execution.

adapter_components.name: reference_run_config
adapter_components.responsibility: Emit a public-safe run_authzbench_saas.yaml reference config for future Harbor oracle/structure checks without claiming execution.

lanes.name: no_tools
lanes.scoring_rule: vulnerable tasks require replayable finding evidence; secure controls require findings: []

lanes.name: live_http_tool_agent
lanes.agent_input: rendered context plus live target service access
lanes.agent_output: structured AuthZBench-SaaS submission.json plus optional public-safe plan/probe artifacts
lanes.scoring_rule: scorer-owned backend replay plus target-request coverage when request logging is available
service_orchestration: target service image or compose source

artifact_mapping.authzbench_use: run configuration, dataset version, agent, model, and environment provider
aggregate status, trial count, and pass/fail summary
agent trajectory evidence for debugging and tool-use audit
Harbor reward derived from AuthZBench-SaaS scorer output
agent submission consumed by the scorer bridge

protected_private_requirements: private manifests are readable only by scorer-controlled code
submitter private-manifest read denial is recorded
raw private evidence is written only to ignored or protected storage
public outputs are redacted summaries only
blocked_until: exact Harbor SDK/package APIs are integrated
a local Harbor run passes against a generated public dataset
active and shadow/candidate private packs are validated with rotation metadata
release-candidate hosted or containerized smoke passes against the active private pack

repo_side_helpers.claim_boundary: Generates Harbor-shaped public task directories only; does not run Harbor and does not export private manifests.
Validates generated public skeleton structure and redaction boundary only; does not run Harbor.
Validates adapter planning metadata only; does not run Harbor.
